Thursday 2025/05/15, 6:00 UTC
Duration: 2 hours

-----------------------------------------------

📝Update Note:

➡️Glorious Anniversary Celebration
-Daily login and event collection, Celebration Rewards never stop!
-New milestone missions: join all Commanders server-wide to win the final reward!
-Review the achievements of the past year and thank every Commander for making the Renney Sector so wonderful!
-Christmas & Spring Festival ships return for a limited time to boost the Celebration!
-Lucky Reorganizer joins the Celebration—who will be the next lucky one!
-Pilot your ship and complete the Expansion Operation for continuous rewards!

MISCELLANEOUS

➡️New ship: Vexora Dreadnought (To Be Released)

- Vexora has been added to the Gaia Manual, to be released in a future update in Matrix Servers first. Stay tuned!

➡️New personal research type: Re-activatable Research
- Unlocked after reaching certain Progress in Station/Matrix Research Path

- Added a new generic ship coating the for Sleigh of Joy Battleship, no need to celebrate Christmas all year anymore!

- Optimized the display of the Starry Treasure event prompt. Now, it will only display once per day when you log in the game.

- In Galaxy Elysium, commander server ID is now displayed in the alliance list

- Title Selection Crates will now display Obtained Effect and Equipped Effect of the Title

- Increased the amount of free refresh for industrial ship research from 2 to 4 times

- In events, removed regular Scavengers from the solar system info panel to display special Scavengers instead

- Changed the Admiral Memory Expansion Pack obtained from the Monthly Log-in event to an Admiral Skill Crate

notes.title: Maintenance Schedule
notes.content:
❗Commanders, servers will be undergoing maintenance for update:

Thursday 2025/04/17, 6:00 UTC
Duration: 2 hours

-----------------------------------------------

📝Update Note:

➡️New Social Feature: Holographic Berth
- In the Holographic Berth, each Commander will have their own berth. The number of available berths and the max ship capacity will gradually unlock according to the commander's level.
- Commanders can park ships in allies' or friends' berths. Parked ships will generate earnings based on parking duration.
- The earnings can be exchanged for various items in the store. Higher commander levels unlock more item types for exchange.

➡️Easter Event
- Daily login, active collection, mission completion - abundant spring benefits!
- The hide-and-seek loving rabbit is drawn by the festive joy. Who will become the top rabbit catcher!
- Spring isn't complete without mini-games! Catch the golden eggs falling everywhere and grab these rewards!
- Search for 3 Easter Eggs hidden in the event interfaces! Can you find them all?

➡️New Scavenger: Avenger
- Attack various Scavengers to accumulate Scavenger Anger - once Anger is full, an Avenger assault will be triggered! Defeat them to earn rich rewards!
- Avenger strength scales with your strength, higher levels grant rarer loots, daily attempts are limited

➡️Starfield Guardian
- The alliance leader who wins the War of Goliath will automatically become the Starfield Guardian of his server
- The Starfield Guardian has a temporary term where he can issue Galaxy Decrees, applying certain buffs to his server and send rewards to certain players

➡️MISCELLANEOUS

- Increased the recovery rate and the cap of Repair Points (the recovery rate and cap will increase with the level of Ship Center)
- You can now select your preferred language for translations in the game settings
- Improved the map marks' appearance
- The detailed event schedule will now be displayed in the in-game event schedule
- Killing Shroud Shadow Fleets in the Crisis of Shroud event will now also count as destroying Scavenger strength in Member Quests
- You can now consume RC and Crystals in your Combat Lab for Emergency Repair Cores
- Updated the Crisis of Shroud shop with new items
- Added M-sized Engine in the Navigator Race Shop
- Declaration of war emails will now only be sent to the Alliance management. - Everyone will still be able to see the declaration of war notifications in the world chat and Alliance chat
- Added a quick delivery button for Orders
- Added a defense fleet strength hide toggle
- Shop Event in the Blazing Arena will automatically close when all the items in the shop are purchased
- Added Start-up Investment III (Matrix servers)
- Optimized Charon Spaceway UX and its tutorial
- Optimized the Quick Use UX for buying and using
- Increased the limit of friends you can have from 20 to 30
- War of Goliath (Single-Server) rankings will now only display the first 6 commanders

notes.title: Maintenance Schedule
notes.content:
❗Commanders, servers will be undergoing maintenance for update:

Thursday 2025/03/13, 6:00 UTC
Duration: 2 hours

-----------------------------------------------

📝Update Note:

➡️New event: Citadel of Tempest

- Commanders from different Alliances are divided into three Forces: Bestla, Ymir, and Surtr
- The event unfolds in four stages: Preparation (2 days), Startup (1 day), Engagement (12 hours), and Conclusion (1 day)
- Each stage has its own gameplay and rewards. Stay strategic for battles and hungry for rewards!
- Use the Sand Table to view the battlefield in real-time and make plans. Let's see whose plan works out the best!
- Event points used to exchange items in the event shop will not be removed and can be accumulated.
- Time-limited chatbox theme and various other rewards await you in the personal damage ranking list

➡️New event: Infinite Campaign

- Knockout-style battles where participants join Team Stardust or Team Starlight in the Hyperspace Warfare event. Winners advance each round until the final champion is determined
- Players can place bets on servers involved in the event

➡️New event: Cosmo Exploration Fest

- Bravery is the anthem of humanity, the discovery of the unknown is worth commemorating!
- Log in, collect, and participate in various other small activities to offer rich rewards!
- Try out the Sunny Lottery and see if you're the luckiest commander in the Renney Sector
- Black Market search and exclusive Battlepass with flooding rewards
- This event will include Selectable Black Markets for Halloween and the Mid-autumn

➡️Black Market:

- The guaranteed draw of limited black markets will be added
- The remaining draws to trigger the guarantee will be displayed on the special black market screens. Single draws will not trigger or reset the guarantee
- Within 3 business days after the update, commanders will receive a set amount of Special Black Market Nameplates as compensation based on the search times in the Special Black Markets and their types available in the past 2 months

MISCELLANEOUS

➡️Blazing Arena Optimizations:

- Optimized the location share in Blazing Arena
- Personal Rank will display personal points
- NPC enemy Hellfire Scavengers will now spawn on Combat Blocks
- NPC defense fleets will spawn on the Garrison Post blocks when the ownership changes
- Combo Kills will now include NPC fleets, also adjusted the points obtained from Combo Kills

- A server load optimization test is underway to reduce lag during intense battles. It will first launch on select servers before gradually expanding to all servers once stable. Stay tuned for future announcements on the rollout plan First batch of selected servers: 4, 12, 22, 57, 69, 93, 5, 32, 41, 50, 87, 94, 23, 26, 78, 90, 92, 100 (this will take effect after the version update)

- Added new levels and rewards to the IronPass. After the update, the current season of IronPass will be directly concluded, and the uncollected rewards and the remaining rewards will be emailed to you within 3 business days

- Added a tutorial for fleet strength in order to help new commanders better understand the strength mechanics while editing fleets

- Commanders can now be redirected to Component Production interface when tapping the components in the ship Recommended Configuration screen

- Summoning the Red Apocalypse will now cost Alliance Fund. Increased the Alliance Fund cost of activating Marauder Crisis. The cost of Alliance Fund when declaring war against another Alliance will now depend on the level of the target Alliance.

- Increased the limit for using a resource item (crystal & alloy) from 100 to 999

- During preparation stage of Alliance war, commanders can now go to the enemy alliance territory and complete Faction Missions

- Workships will now return to space station automatically when no resource or wreckage is found at their destination

- Alliance Shared Welfare crates will now be removed from emails and relocated to the Alliance screen

- The damage inflicted by space station Fortifications will now also be displayed in Battle Reports

- Added toggles in the game Settings for ship acceleration buttons on the map

- Selectable Black Markets will now be displayed in the in-game schedule

- Optimized the text descriptions for skills that only activate in combat

- The "Buy and Use" button for fleet acceleration items will now have a confirmation pop-up window

- Added a confirmation pop-up window after tapping Claim All in the Mysterious Gift tab in the email

- After completing previous chapters in Deep Space Exploration, commanders will now be redirected to new chapters automatically

- Optimized the notification when tapping Quick Formation

- Added commander level restriction (Lv.15) to the Blazing Arena

- Fixed a problem where the Armor Penetration perks in fleet Formations of Admiral Sho Wu, Ann Dickinson, the Resistance Penetration perks in fleet Formation of Serena were not increasing your fleet strength

- The last log-in time of Alliance members will now display  the actual time of the last log-out. And member list will be sorted by Online-Offline

- Optimized the rewards in Marauder Crisis and increased its level to 20

- Red Apocalypse boss max level is now 30

- You can now upgrade your rate 110 components into rate 156 components

- Increased various attributes of your space station fortifications

- Reduced the difficulty of the 1st chapter in Deep Space Exploration

- Added item exchange feature for certain event items. You can select the items in your Stash to exchange them into some other items

- Added Damage Increase & Reduction explanation in the Question button in the Dock interface

notes.title: Maintenance Schedule
notes.content:
❗Commanders, servers will be undergoing maintenance for update:

Friday 2024/12/06, 6:00 UTC
Duration: 2 hours

-----------------------------------------------

📝Update Note:

➡️Christmas Event: Starry Xmas Celebration
- Christmas is here and Santa Armada invites you to participate in all the Christmas events for some fat loot!
- What's in his sack? Avatar frame, new space station theme, new components and the come back of Labarum and Sleigh of Joy!

➡️Ship Coatings:
- You can now apply different coatings to your ships to change their appearance
- A ship coating can only be applied to 1 ship. Dismantling the ship in the ship editing screen will return the applied coating item to your Stash
- Switching to another coating will also return the previous coating to your Stash (default coating cannot be returned)

➡️Interface Themes:
- You can now change the appearance of some parts of the game by changing their theme
- You can change the theme of your chatbox

➡️Balanced certain legendary ship hulls from the special black markets:
- Full log of changes [url=https://tinyurl.com/straxjme]here[/url]

⬇️MISCELLANEOUS

- Improved the traps, new tiers of traps will be available according to server opening time. Full log of changes [url=https://tinyurl.com/straxjme]here[/url]
- Optimized the 4th skills of Admirals. Improved the original effects while adding extra Leadership when leveled up
- Your station will now get a short Quantum Shield when destroyed and relocated into another solar system
- Increased the scavenger strength in Goliath event, as well as the rewards in the event shop based on the server lifetime
- Increased the level of Elite Scavengers to Lv.20 and Chief Scavengers to Lv.7 in Galaxy Elysium. Improved the rewards dropped by Chief Scavengers
- Increased the level of Elite Scavengers to Lv.35 and Chief Scavengers to Lv.10 in Renney Sector. Improved the rewards dropped by Chief Scavengers
- Force managers can now see the mission content as well as the mission title and info when adjusting the Force missions in Galaxy Elysium
- Battle Reports, ships, fleets, and Black Market Search can now be shared to friends
- With the previous adjustments of the commander strength calculation, we increased the Member Quest mission requirements for eliminating Elite Scavengers and regular Scavenger strength
- The Alliance mission tab will be hidden once all the missions are completed and the rewards are claimed
- Adjusted the mission requirements in Galaxy Elysium. Added extra mission tiers to PvP missions in Galaxy Elysium
- Reduced the GEC price of the rewards in Planet Exploration Shop, commanders of different levels will see different items in the Planet Exploration shop
- Adjusted the Daily Special packs in the game shop
- Added server number display when switching to another character
- Optimized the RC display in Orders
- After Matrix, Advanced IronPass will have 10 extra crates as level rewards
- The deadline for claiming World Event rewards has been changed to 00:00 UTC on the fourth day after the stage is completed
- Added server stars to the server list and removed population status
